keyWhy.ko: 핵심은 «김치의 특별한 맛은 발효라는 자연적인 과정에서 나온다(주제)» 와 «발효 덕분에 김치는 맛도 좋고 건강에도 좋다(결론)» 입니다. 초록색 문장이 정답이에요.
keyWhy.en: The key ideas are the topic (kimchi’s special taste comes from fermentation) and the conclusion (thanks to fermentation, kimchi is delicious and good for your health). The green sentences are the answers.

boxes.a: Kimchi tastes sour and lasts a long time

sumHowto.ko: 먼저 위 세 칸을 보고, 빈칸에 알맞은 단어를 고르세요.
sumHowto.en: Look at the three boxes, then choose the right word for each blank.

sum.pre: Kimchi is made by mixing vegetables with salt and
start to grow. They change sugars into acids, which gives kimchi its
flavor. In the past, families made large amounts of kimchi in late
to eat during the winter. This tradition is called kimjang.

words: its special taste comes from a natural process called fermentation.
a natural change in food made by tiny living things
the kimchi is stored in a cool place for some time.
kept in a place to use later
tiny living things called lactic acid bacteria start to grow.

something people have done for a long time

qs.q: Why can kimchi be kept for a long time?
qs.qko: 김치는 왜 오래 보관할 수 있나요?
opts: Because salt and acid stop harmful germs from growing
Because it is eaten only in late autumn
Because it has no vegetables in it
evs: The salt and acid also stop many harmful germs from growing, so kimchi can be kept for a long time.
To make kimchi, people mix vegetables like napa cabbage and radish with salt and spices.
This tradition, called kimjang, is still important in Korea today.
Then the kimchi is stored in a cool place for some time.
why: 소금과 산이 해로운 세균이 자라지 못하게 막아서 김치를 오래 보관할 수 있다고 했어요.
The salt and acid stop many harmful germs from growing, so kimchi can be kept for a long time.

qs.q: In "its sour, tangy flavor," what does "tangy" mean?
qs.qko: «its sour, tangy flavor» 에서 «tangy» 는 무슨 뜻인가요?
evs: This is what gives kimchi its sour, tangy flavor.
Kimchi is a famous Korean food, and its special taste comes from a natural process called fermentation.
In the past, families made large amounts of kimchi in late autumn to eat during the winter.
During this time, tiny living things called lactic acid bacteria start to grow.
why: «sour(새콤한)» 와 나란히 쓰여 김치의 맛을 꾸며 주니, tangy 는 톡 쏘고 새콤한 맛이라는 뜻이에요.
«Tangy» is used together with «sour» to describe the flavor, so it means sharp and a little sour.

qs.q: How do the bacteria give kimchi its sour taste?
qs.qko: 유산균은 어떻게 김치에 새콤한 맛을 주나요?
opts: They change the sugars in the vegetables into acids
They add more salt to the cabbage
They make the kimchi very hot
evs: These good bacteria change the sugars in the vegetables into acids.
Then the kimchi is stored in a cool place for some time.
This is what gives kimchi its sour, tangy flavor.
This tradition, called kimjang, is still important in Korea today.
why: 좋은 균이 채소의 당분을 산으로 바꾸고, «이것이» 김치에 새콤하고 톡 쏘는 맛을 준다고 했어요. 두 문장을 이어야 해요.
The good bacteria change the sugars into acids, and «this» gives kimchi its sour, tangy flavor. You need both sentences.

ends: What other foods around the world are fermented?
세계에는 또 어떤 발효 음식이 있을까요?
How do families make kimchi together at kimjang time?
김장 때 가족들은 어떻게 함께 김치를 담글까요?

write.src: “If <u>we keep kimchi in a cool place</u>, we can <u>enjoy it all winter</u>.”
write.howtoKo: 예문을 틀로 삼아, 빈칸 두 곳을 «만약 ~하면 + 우리가 할 수 있는 일» 로 바꿔 영어로 써 보세요.
write.howtoEn: Use the example as a pattern. Write a condition and what we can do then in English.
write.moreKo: 한 걸음 더: «If» 뒤에 «누가 + 무엇을 하면» 을 분명하게 써 보세요. (예: If we eat kimchi often)
write.moreEn: One more step: after «If», write who + what they do. (e.g. If we eat kimchi often)
